calls.statement:
WITH contacted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19
),
web AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order
),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, m.member_id, f.net_amount, s.store_id, p.category, f.sale_date, f.staff_purchase_flag,
         w.status, w.dispatch_date,
         CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS recog_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  JOIN contacted c ON c.member_id=m.member_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND s.store_id=900
)
SELECT store_id=900 AS is_web, status, count(*) AS n, count(distinct member_id) AS mem, sum(net_amount) AS net,
 sum(case when recog_date between DATE '2026-05-04' and DATE '2026-05-24' then net_amount end) AS net_in_window,
 sum(case when sale_date between DATE '2026-05-04' and DATE '2026-05-24' then net_amount end) AS net_saledate_window,
 sum(case when store_id=999 or category='ZZ Test' then 1 else 0 end) AS test_lines,
 sum(case when staff_purchase_flag then 1 else 0 end) AS staff_lines
FROM lines
WHERE sale_date between DATE '2026-04-25' and DATE '2026-06-10' OR recog_date between DATE '2026-04-25' and DATE '2026-06-10'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) AS n, count(distinct sales_line_id) AS ids, count(distinct (receipt_id, line_no)) AS rl,
 min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx, max(etl_loaded_at) AS loaded,
 count(distinct case when sale_date between DATE '2026-05-04' and DATE '2026-05-24' then sale_date end) AS days_in_window,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
 (SELECT string_agg(fiscal_period_label || ':' || cast(fully_loaded as varchar), ', ') FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE period_start_date <= DATE '2026-06-30' AND period_end_date >= DATE '2026-04-01') AS loadflags
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date between DATE '2026-04-20' and DATE '2026-06-30'

SELECT count(*) AS n, count(f.member_key) AS with_key, count(m.member_key) AS matched_key,
 count(distinct f.member_key) AS dk, count(distinct m.member_id) AS dm,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dupe_keys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT campaign_id, member_id FROM campaign_holdout GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dupe_holdout,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) AS holdout_rows
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
WHERE f.sale_date between DATE '2026-05-04' and DATE '2026-05-24'

calls.statement:
WITH contacted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
spend AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN contacted c ON c.member_id = m.member_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = r.member_key JOIN contacted c ON c.member_id = m.member_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM contacted) AS members_contacted,
       (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM spend) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       (SELECT count(distinct member_id) FROM spend) AS buyers,
       (SELECT sum(refund_net) FROM refunds) AS refunds_net
